subject: Workshop refund query
body:
Nora, I have the refund reference saved now. This is about the evening spreadsheet workshop, not the missing course everybody is discussing today.

The confirmation says received, which I understand isn't a decision. I'm just checking whether I should expect the normal support reply or whether the timetable is changing this morning. I don't need to submit again.

Thanks for sorting the form wording. It is much easier to tell what happens next than in the first version I used. Hadi
